description: This script is a command-line interface (CLI) tool for managing translation of documentation files in a FastAPI project. It provides functions for translating pages, managing translation files, checking for outdated or missing translations, and automating pull request creation for synchronization with GitHub. It leverages external libraries such as Typer for CLI, GitPython for repository management, Github API for PRs, and other libraries for file handling, text translation prompts, and YAML processing.

methods.name: dict[str,str] get_langs()
methods.description: Loads language names from a YAML configuration file, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: Path generate_lang_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
